package.description: Third-party PlayStation Remote Play streaming client, formerly known as PSPlay.

en-US.description: Third-party PlayStation Remote Play streaming client, formerly known as PSPlay.
en-US.longDescription: PXPlay (formerly PSPlay) is a third-party PlayStation Remote Play streaming client for Windows, Linux, and macOS. It supports PlayStation 4 and 5 consoles with features including custom gamepad button mapping, advanced GPU-accelerated decoding with zero-copy D3D11 and Vulkan rendering, FSR 1.0 spatial upscaling up to 4K, HDR output support, and multi-language UI.
en-US.name: PXPlay
